english.text: As I stood upon the bluff before my cottage on that clear cold night in the early part of March, 1886, the noble Hudson flowing like the grey and silent spectre of a dead river below me, I felt again the strange, compelling influence of the mighty god of war, my beloved Mars, which for ten long and lonesome years I had implored with outstretched arms to carry me back to my lost love.

text: 1886 年 3 月初，喺嗰個清澈嘅寒冷夜晚，當我企喺我小屋前嘅懸崖上，高貴嘅哈德遜河好似我下面一條死河嘅灰色而無聲嘅幽靈噉流動，我再次感受到嗰個奇怪而引人入勝嘅影響強大嘅戰神，我心愛嘅火星，十年來，我用伸出嘅手臂懇求佢帶我返去我失去嘅愛身邊。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: The Ram is called in Egyptian ba on account of the digs which he makes with his head, and a force which has occasioned the name of 'ram' to be given to powerful engines. The Heron is also called ba because with its bill it cleaves the fishes which it attacks. And the word which we translate Soul or Spirit is called ba, because it is conceived as something which 'pierces, penetrates and divides.'

jyutping: joeng4 hai2 oi1 kap6 man4 jap6 min6 giu3 zou6 ba ，jan1 wai6 keoi5 jung6 tau4 waat3，tung4 maai4 jat1 zung2 lik6 loeng6，ling6 dou3 koeng4 daai6 ge3 jan5 king4 jau5「joeng4」ni1 go3 meng2。jing1 jik6 dou1 giu3 zou6 ba ，jan1 wai6 keoi5 jung6 keoi5 go3 zeoi2 pek3 hoi1 keoi5 gung1 gik1 ge3 jyu4。ji4 ngo5 dei6 faan1 jik6 ge3 ling4 wan4 waak6 ze2 ling4 wan4 ni1 go3 zi6 giu3 zou6 baa1，jan1 wai6 keoi5 bei6 jing6 wai4 hai6 jat1 zung2「cyun1 tau3、cyun1 tau3 tung4 fan1 lit6」ge3 je5。
text: 羊喺埃及文入面叫做 ba ，因為佢用頭挖，同埋一種力量，令到強大嘅引擎有「羊」呢個名。鷹亦都叫做 ba ，因為佢用佢個嘴劈開佢攻擊嘅魚。而我哋翻譯嘅靈魂或者靈魂呢個字叫做巴，因為佢被認為係一種「穿透、穿透同分裂」嘅嘢。
